cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her left side; a walled garden with a lotus pond — sitting on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a sunlit white marble temple — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — pours from a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord into a small cup on the table; her bedroom — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds her keepsake at chest height; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — seated on the saddle of the parked bike
